home.hero_subtitle: Report civic issues. Verify fixes. Hold agencies accountable.
home.step1_desc: Snap a photo of any civic issue — pothole, garbage, broken light, or water leak. Our AI instantly categorizes and routes it.
home.step2_desc: Nearby citizens confirm the issue exists. Duplicate reports within 50m auto-merge into a single ticket.
home.step3_desc: When agencies mark it fixed, citizens vote whether the fix is real. Fake fixes get reopened instantly.

about.title: About NagarSetu
about.mission_desc: NagarSetu bridges the gap between citizens and municipal agencies by creating a transparent, gamified platform for civic issue reporting and resolution.
about.vision_desc: A future where every citizen has the power to improve their neighborhood, and every agency is held accountable through citizen-verified audits.
about.value1_desc: Every fix is citizen-verified. No more fake completions.
about.value2_desc: Gamified points reward active civic participation.
about.value3_desc: Agencies are publicly tracked. Discrepancies are flagged.
